ownership_summary.area: Cheat Engine mappings, native ABI safety, Lua protection, and low-level native owners
ownership_summary.client_boundary: Client consumes only supported SDK contracts; it does not reproduce ABI, longjmp, bootstrap, or native-owner mechanics.

ownership_summary.area: Activation workflow, DI composition, policy, and public fluent ergonomics
ownership_summary.client_boundary: Client owns application-facing lifecycle policy and expresses SDK-backed workflows without leaking SDK handles.

ownership_summary.area: Package compatibility, generated-consumer proof, and plugin-host qualification
ownership_summary.client_boundary: SDK supplies the package contract; Client validates its consumer graph. A source observation is not package or live proof.

ownership_summary.area: Fixture and live Cheat Engine qualification
ownership_summary.client_boundary: Client scenarios run only after the corresponding SDK source and package prerequisites are established.

finding_groups.description: Provenance, package identity, generated-consumer, deployment, and capability evidence are planned through the evidence and qualification leaves.
Activation ownership, deterministic rollback, dispatcher behavior, and runtime capability checks are sequenced before high-level workflows.
Client-facing processes, runtime diagnostics, failure mapping, and public contracts remain gated on their upstream SDK contracts.
Target identity changes, retained resources, scanning, and patch ownership are bounded as Client workflows over SDK-native ownership.
Memory codecs, AOB/value scan behavior, tables, configuration policy, and destructive-operation bounds remain explicit consumer responsibilities.
Callbacks, reentrancy, generated modules, AOT, performance, plugin coexistence, and registration are qualified only at their dedicated later gates.

not_proof: The reconciliation does not attest that the archive is a source clone or that its source observations appear in a published package.
The reconciliation does not mark any of the 80 scenarios as fixture- or live-executed.
The reconciliation does not replace the controlled Cheat Engine 7.7 live qualification gate.
